from fractions import Fraction as F
from itertools import combinations_with_replacement

# Condition: f(0)=prod r_i, f(1)=prod (1-r_i), so we need prod r = prod (1-r).
# Then P^2 = prod r_i(1-r_i) <= (1/4)^6, since r(1-r) <= 1/4, so P <= 1/64 and 1/P >= 64.

half = [F(1, 2)] * 6
P = 1
Q = 1
for r in half:
    P *= r
    Q *= (1 - r)
print("all roots 1/2: f(0) =", P, " f(1) =", Q, " 1/P =", 1 / P)
equal_ok = (P == Q)

# Exhaustive grid check: multisets of 6 roots from multiples of 1/20 (sampling only, not a proof)
N = 20
vals = [F(i, N) for i in range(N + 1)]
best = None
count = 0
for combo in combinations_with_replacement(range(N + 1), 6):
    p = 1
    q = 1
    for i in combo:
        p *= i
        q *= (N - i)
    if p == q and p != 0:
        count += 1
        inv = F(N ** 6, p)
        if best is None or inv < best:
            best = inv
print("grid feasible multisets (nonzero product):", count)
print("grid minimum of 1/P:", best)

# Exact bound check: max of r(1-r) over grid is 1/4
mx = max(v * (1 - v) for v in vals)
print("max r(1-r) on grid:", mx)

submitted = 1
if equal_ok and best == 64 and submitted == 64:
    print("CHECK PASS")
else:
    print("Expected minimum is 64 (attained at all roots 1/2, bound P<=1/64 by AM-GM); submitted", submitted)
    print("CHECK FAIL")
